'''Dinnd''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]]. Fried dinnd was a spicy [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] delicacy that [[Danta Belissa]] sold at his food and souvenir store on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].
